I’m using a Visa ending in 5873, the same one I’ve used for the past year.

The message says “transaction could not be processed” and I’ve attached a screenshot of the screen.
Understood. Would you like to try a different card or perhaps a PayPal link while we look into the issue?
I’ll attempt another card shortly, but I still need confirmation that my account will stay active before the deadline.
